title: Prestige
notes: Player levels now go up to 100, with five new ranks ending at Eternal Flame.
Prestige: at level 100, start the climb again for new rewards, up to Prestige X. You keep moonstones, passes, skins and lanterns with their mastery.
Prestige shop: 20 Prestige skins, the most detailed in the game. They react when you tap them and when they fire.
Oblivion: a new difficulty above Nightmare, unlocked by your first prestige.
Mastery prestige: reset a lantern from Mastery 100 to 1 for a permanent +2%, up to 10 times.
Lantern upgrades and ascensions cost about twice as much. Founder's gold has a double halo, and REDACTED is now the Founders Edition code.
